name: mcp-use
description: Full-stack MCP framework for building MCP apps, clients and servers.
descriptionZh: 全栈 MCP 框架，用于构建 MCP 应用、客户端与服务器。
keyFact: mcp-use is an MIT-licensed, full-stack MCP framework that can build both MCP Apps for ChatGPT and Claude and MCP servers; it was created by Pietro Zullo and now lives under the mcp-use organization, publishing both a Python package and @mcp-use npm packages.
keyFactZh: mcp-use 是 MIT 许可的全栈 MCP 框架，既可构建面向 ChatGPT 与 Claude 的 MCP App，也可构建 MCP Server；它由 Pietro Zullo 创建，现归属 mcp-use 组织，同时发布 Python 包与 @mcp-use npm 包。
